newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Aug manufacturing employment up 4.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Aug manufacturing employment up 4.7 pct.

text.p: Manufacturing employment rose 4.7 percent in August against the same month last year, the national statistics institute INEGI said Thursday.
INEGI said in a statement that August was the fifth consecutive month this year that had shown a rise in manufacturing employment.

Among the different manufacturing sectors, INEGI said the textile and leather industries saw an annualised rise in employment of 11 percent. Metal products and machinery sector employment rose 10.1 percent, basic metal industry jobs by 6.7 percent, wood and wood products by 5.0 percent, chemicals, rubber and plastics by 4.2 percent, non-metal mineral products by 1.5 percent, food drink and tobacco by 0.7 percent and other industries by 11.9 percent.
The only division to record a fall was paper, printing and publishing, with a drop in August jobs of 0.1 percent.
